item.apprenticecodex.scarlet_thirst.desc: Converts excess health into mana when mana is low.
Improves efficiency and performance of magic buzzsaw and drill.
Use while crouching to seal magic power.
spell.apprenticecodex.sky_edge.guide: Summons a weapon that fires in the direction of your gaze. It takes time to fire and has no knockback, but it can ignore the target’s invincibility frames.
spell.apprenticecodex.archer_multiple.gu: Summons a magical bow that follows you and continues attacking the designated target—or nearby enemies—until it runs out of ammunition.
spell.apprenticecodex.commence_fire.guid: Summons a magical rifle that follows you. Then, upon use, unleashes a powerful ranged shooting attack.
spell.apprenticecodex.compound_phial.gui: Concocts a potion immediately and throws it. Bypasses defense, but may also strike the user.
spell.apprenticecodex.quick_arms.guide: Summons a magical handgun and fires bullet. Can fire multiple bullets in a short time.
spell.apprenticecodex.breaching_enemy.gu: Summons a magical shotgun and fires bullet. Short range, but powerful knockback.
spell.apprenticecodex.bullet_stream.guid: Summons a magical minigun and keeps firing bullets continuously. No knockback, but can ignore the target’s invincibility frames.
spell.apprenticecodex.arcane_blast.guide: Blasts the target with magic power and increases spell power. Can bypass armor, but ineffective like magic user. Replica of the fabric wizard's spell.
spell.apprenticecodex.arcane_beam.guide: Continuously fires a beam of magic power along a straight line. Increases in power with accumulated magic power. Can bypass armor, but ineffective like magic user. Replica of the fabric wizard's spell.
spell.apprenticecodex.tiny_lumberjack.gu: Summons a magical buzzsaw and cuts through the target's body. Can be used to cut through trees.
spell.apprenticecodex.graced_rain.guide: Summons a healing rain cloud that heals living beings submerged in it. Healing is beneficial to plants.
spell.apprenticecodex.mage_light.guide: Summons a magical torch that illuminates the surroundings and place. A magical torch does not require support.
spell.apprenticecodex.personal_shelf.gui: Summons a magical chest that can be used to store items. The chest disappears after a certain period of time or when it is moved away. The chest is an interface to individual space. Use while sneaking it will attempt to move items to the chest used.
spell.apprenticecodex.fly_swatter.guide: Summons a magical launcher that attacks the target captured in the direction of the gaze. Attacks follow the target.
spell.apprenticecodex.assist_wings.guide: Summons magical wings that allows jumping by flapping. Can be used in the air but used only a certain number of times depending on magic power. After activation, it will fall slowly until landing and will not take fall damage.
spell.apprenticecodex.world_flatter.guid: Summons a magical drill that pierces the target in the direction of the gaze. Can also quickly open a large hole by swinging it towards the ground.
spell.apprenticecodex.slash_blade.guide: Summon a magic blade and strike in an instant. Uninterruptible.
death.attack.apprenticecodex.commence_fi: %1$s got their pretty face knocked in by %2$s.
death.attack.apprenticecodex.graced_rain: The power of grace was too harmful to %1$s.
